question: Does exact current main contain a repeated authored same-phase opportunity for TARGET_ACTS_LAST_THIS_PHASE, and can one minimal research-only prototype preserve a provable disabled path while exposing one exact direct-consume observable?

selectedAbstractContract.definition: Before the next enemy phase resolves any living enemy, stable-partition the existing living-enemy iteration so the marked enemy acts after every unmarked enemy. Preserve each enemy's exact move, internal effect order, action count, target, history update, RNG identity and post-phase intent recomputation; consume the marker after the phase.
selectedAbstractContract.carrier: One research-only Duskblade Skill action, costing exactly one Energy and targeting one living enemy, applies one fight-local marker and has no bundled effect.
selectedAbstractContract.repeatRule: A second application to the same target is idempotent; a later application to a different target replaces the pending target without stacking.
selectedAbstractContract.expiry: The marker expires after the next enemy phase, marked-target death, combat end or aspect mismatch and never enters run state or a save.

scoreline.definition: Duskblade exact Chisel realised hit sets one target-local non-stacking mark; a later exact Executioner on that living target consumes it for one separate bounded raw damage operation.
scoreline.independence: Separate causal factor; never pooled with the scheduler transform.

afterimage.definition: Duskblade exact Defend realised Ward sets one player-local non-stacking bounded value; a later exact Warden's Edge in the same player turn consumes it for one separate mirrored-Ward operation.
afterimage.independence: Separate causal factor; never pooled with the scheduler transform.

frozenCausalFactors.interactionRule: No interaction is estimated here. Any later joint cells require shared common-random-number transform-only, Scoreline-only and Afterimage-only interference anchors with measured decision value.

naturalOpportunityCensus.unit: One authored multi-enemy encounter definition whose first enemy is tidecaller and whose later enemy has only damaging possible first-turn moves.
naturalOpportunityCensus.producerPredicate: tidecaller is first in authored encounter order; EnemyAi selects surge on turn 1; surge applies exactly +2 str to all living enemies after tidecaller's own action.
naturalOpportunityCensus.consumerPredicate: Every possible first-turn move of every later enemy has authored dmg and at least one packet; damage_player reads attacker str before weak/vulnerable and block resolution.
naturalOpportunityCensus.contrast: Baseline authored order versus stable-moving tidecaller to the last living slot, with the same enemies, move identities, RNG identity and internal move order.

estimands.witnessEncounterDefinitions: Count of distinct act/tier/index encounter definitions satisfying both predicates.
estimands.distinctLaterEnemyIds: Count of distinct later enemy identities across witnesses.
estimands.guaranteedFirstTurnStrengthExposures: Minimum number of later first-turn attack packets that receive tidecaller's +2 str in authored order and do not receive that same-phase increment when tidecaller acts last.

minimalResearchPrototype.productStatus: Research-only source/content projection outside product truth; not a candidate or shipping scope.
minimalResearchPrototype.configuration: One configure_research421_target_acts_last(enabled: bool) switch defaults false. Current-main content contains no research card, so the disabled whole-run arm cannot activate the producer.

card.aspect: Duskblade only by harness construction; invalid outside aspect 0

marker.producer: Clear the key from every enemy, then set it on the selected living target only when enabled and aspect is Duskblade.
marker.consumer: Use a local phase-order array without mutating cb.enemies; erase the marker on all normal, death and combat-end exits before ordinary intent recomputation.

gameplayHooks: One _apply_special producer branch for the exact research special ID.
One enemy-phase order helper called only behind the default-false research switch.

event.cardinality: Exactly one event per eligible marker consumption; zero when disabled or no marker exists.

minimalResearchPrototype.policyBoundary: Existing ordinary play/no-play and enemy-target enumeration is sufficient for direct identity work. No new policy score, target heuristic, oracle, acquisition override, ML or RL hook is authorised until a later measured gate identifies that bottleneck.

identityGateDesign.wholeRunNull: Compare exact-main source/content with prototype source configured false and exact-main content. Freeze identical policy identities, seeds, estimator and stopping rule; require byte-identical canonical outputs, RNG state, event sequence, result and all existing fields.
identityGateDesign.matchedDirectNull: Within prototype source and identical research-card content, compare configured false versus configured true from the same constructed combat state and RNG identity. Playing the card, Energy cost, hand/discard movement and ordinary PLAY/ENERGY/TO_DISCARD events are common; only marker, order-consume event and resulting enemy action order may differ.
directPositiveScenarios: Turn-1 tidecaller plus voltEel with zero player block/status/relic/vow modifiers: target tidecaller; enabled order must be voltEel then tidecaller and remove exactly one +2 same-phase str exposure from shock.

Turn-1 tidecaller plus mirelurker with a frozen RNG identity selecting either sting or barb: target tidecaller; enabled order must be mirelurker then tidecaller and remove exactly one +2 same-phase str exposure from that attack.
invalidOrExpiryScenarios: Different-target replay replaces rather than stacks.
Already-last target consumes with moved=false and no action-order change.
Marked-target death and combat end clear the marker without save/run state.
identityGateDesign.note: These ceilings bind any immediate identity protocol; that protocol must freeze exact fresh unprotected identities and the selected compliant Godot binary provenance before execution.

staticAudit.implementation: One Python standard-library runner; exact source/hash checks, authored opportunity enumeration and protocol completeness only.
staticAudit.selfTest: Prove encounter filtering, possible-move universal quantification, attack-packet counting, exact required-witness equality, cap enforcement and no-overwrite before the sole live audit.

decision.success: All source identities, exact witnesses, thresholds and minimal prototype/identity-design fields pass. Authorise exactly one separately versioned research prototype and the bound identity gate; do not run capacity or whole-run causal rows here.
decision.futility: The audit is valid but any opportunity threshold or required witness fails. Close TARGET_ACTS_LAST_THIS_PHASE and continue inside #421 with the next distinct evidence-backed structural mechanism.
decision.inconclusive: Any source/hash/schema/cap/no-overwrite fault or exhausted mechanical correction records this gate inconclusive at cap.

claimBoundary: A success proves repeated authored opportunity and a complete bounded research design only. It is not prototype correctness, identity safety, natural capacity, policy sensitivity, complementarity, reachability, a candidate, product scope, #421 acceptance or the #108 P9 receipt.
